new_corner_ood.design: independent uniform LHS inside each predeclared corner box; seed = SEED + 2000 + regime_index * 100 + corner_index

optimum_slice_selection_study.scope: three-input L4 slice surrogate per regime (V1.9-E scope)

physics_digest.algorithm: sha256 over canonical json of the artifact with the benchmark/metadata blocks and all timing-valued keys removed

protocol.buffer_rule: median leave-one-out nearest-neighbor distance of the TRAINING design; ties count as SEPARATED
protocol.distance_metric: Euclidean distance in V1.9-D shared-verified-box normalized coordinates (same as V1.9-E support)
protocol.metric_limitation: equal weight per normalized unit across axes with very different physical spans; no post-hoc log variant
protocol.role_discipline: refits use TRAIN/ADAPTIVE_TRAIN (scope roles inside slices); FINAL rows never fit or select
protocol.stratification: INTERPOLATION (d < buffer) vs SEPARATED (d >= buffer); strata with < 8 points report counts only
